scope: Permanent health monitoring for subscribed Fortnite, Harry Potter and Pokemon calendars in QuentinGranger/demo

principles.subscription_path_stability: A subscribed .ics path on the pinned master branch is a public compatibility contract. Never rename/remove it silently. If an internal migration is needed, keep the old path as a valid compatibility mirror unless the user explicitly accepts a subscription URL change.
principles.no_expiry: Recurring monitor schedules must not contain RRULE UNTIL or COUNT unless explicitly requested by the user.
principles.no_news_is_not_failure: A calendar may legitimately receive no Git commit for a long period. Health is based on automation liveness, repository/path availability and ICS integrity, not on file modification frequency alone.
principles.incident_only_writes: Routine healthy checks do not update calendar-health-state.json. Persist only OPEN/ESCALATED/RECOVERED incident transitions or a deliberate policy migration.
principles.respect_manual_control: Never silently re-enable an automation the user deliberately disabled. Detect and report disabled/finite/stale monitoring instead.
principles.same_path_repair: If a subscribed ICS is damaged or deleted and can be deterministically repaired from canonical ledgers without inventing facts, restore the same master-branch path rather than creating a replacement URL.
principles.cross_watch: The three main franchise monitors should check one another's liveness so a stopped monitor can be detected by a different still-running monitor.

automation_liveness.first_run_rule: If last_run_time is null, do not fail before the first recurrence that should occur after the automation's latest update/create time plus the cadence grace window.
automation_liveness.finite_rule: A recurring health-critical monitor is finite if its RRULE contains UNTIL or COUNT.
automation_liveness.enabled_rule: is_enabled must remain true unless the user intentionally changes it.

required: no duplicate VEVENT UID within one file
ics_checks.franchise_specific_validation: Run the franchise's existing stricter validator whenever one exists. Generic health validation does not replace domain-specific validation.
ics_checks.raw_subscription_contract: raw.githubusercontent.com/QuentinGranger/demo/master/<path> must continue to map to the same subscribed path. Do not silently migrate to a different branch or filename.

run_protocol: Verify repository and pinned master branch availability.
Verify all subscribed global paths and franchise specialist paths still exist.
Run generic ICS structural checks and available franchise validators.
Use automations state to verify the three main monitors and declared supporting monitors are enabled, recurring without UNTIL/COUNT, and not stale beyond policy thresholds.
Do not classify an unchanged calendar file as stale if its monitor is healthy and no material source change was found.
For each new incident, fresh-fetch calendar-health-state.json, append OPEN through compare-and-swap, and notify once.
While the same incident remains OPEN, stay silent.
When the exact incident clears, append RECOVERED and notify once that monitoring is healthy again.
Never create a separate recurring automation solely for this health check when the existing franchise monitors can perform it.
